headlines.title: Crowdstrike is spending $43.9 billion to buy ZScaler in a huge cybersecurity deal as tech outages spread
headlines.summary: A big deal in cybersecurity has hit.

headlines.title: Premarket movers: Chip stocks lead AI rebound; CrowdStrike falls
headlines.summary: nvesting.com - U.S. stock index futures rallied on Monday, as investors stepped in to buy beaten-down technology shares following a bruising week on Wall Street that pushed all three major equity benchmarks into correction territory. A sharp rebound in semiconductor and artificial intelligence-related stocks helped lift sentiment, while a major cybersecurity acquisition added to the premarket activity.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Agrees To Buy Zscaler For $43.9 Billion. Shares Move In Opposite Directions.
headlines.summary: The planned merger would bring device protection and cloud network security under one platform, opening access to thousands of additional customers as corporate demand for AI safeguards grows.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike to Buy Zscaler in $44 Billion All-Stock Deal. Why They’re Better Off Together.
headlines.summary: Under the terms of the agreement, Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike common stock for each share of Zscaler common stock they own.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike To Acquire Zscaler For $43.9B In All-Stock Deal: TD Cowen Sees Cybersecurity Consolidation Entering ‘More Material Phase’
headlines.summary: Zscaler and CrowdStrike also reported quarterly results on Monday, with both companies beating analyst estimates for revenue and earnings.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
